description: Submit a moving quote request to Ontrack. Ask conversationally for name, contact, origin, destination, date and size; unknown destination/date/size may be empty. Show a summary and obtain explicit customer permission to share with Ontrack before calling. Never invent missing details, quote a price or promise a booking. Only a saved receipt means the request was received. Requests that pass screening go directly to sales; exceptions are saved for staff follow-up. Use the returned status to distinguish saved from received_by_sales. Requires an enabled Ontrack tool connection in the customer’s assistant.

assistant.description: Self-reported assistant name; not verified attribution.

customer_confirmed.description: Set true only after showing the customer these details and obtaining explicit permission to share them with Ontrack for a moving quote and contact by phone/email. This does not enroll them in SMS.

destination.description: Destination city/state or address; leave empty if unknown.

email.description: Customer email, or empty if phone provided.

idempotency_key.description: Generate a random UUID or 128-bit random key for this move. Reuse the exact key and details on retries. Use a new key for a different move.

move_size.description: Home/office size or inventory summary, or empty if unknown.

notes.description: Move needs only. Do not send payment details, passwords, identity documents or unrelated conversation.

origin.description: Origin city and state or full address, as provided by the customer.

phone.description: Customer phone including area/country code, or empty if email provided.

name: request_moving_quote
title: Request an Ontrack moving quote
